This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Destiny" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|dark blue]] skin that grew lighter around their mouth and nose.<ref name="Destiny" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[148 BBY]]<ref name="AcolyteTimeline">The events of "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]]" take place sixteen [[Standard year|years]] before the present day events of ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which occur in [[132 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TheAcolyteDate|here]].</ref> a member of this species served as a prominent member among a [[Brendok coven|coven]] found on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]].<ref name="Destiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Destiny (The Acolyte)|third episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Kogonada]].<ref name="Destiny" />
